name: Unthankful People
overview: Scripture reveals that unthankfulness is a serious spiritual condition, as seen in Romans 1:21 where those who know God yet fail to glorify Him and give thanks become darkened in their hearts. Jesus teaches that loving only those who love us yields no true reward, for even sinners do the same (Luke 6:32). Instead, believers are called to love and do good to their enemies without expecting gratitude, reflecting God's kindness toward the unthankful and the evil (Luke 6:35). This grace is exemplified supremely in Christ’s reconciliation of enemies to God through His death, assuring salvation despite our former enmity (Romans 5:10). Practical expressions of love toward those who may not be thankful, such as feeding a hungry enemy (Proverbs 25:21), demonstrate the heart of Christian obedience amidst unthankfulness.
